note: Draft register written after ad hoc testing: every item below was derived from the observed behaviour of the stand and is NOT yet confirmed by the product owner. Confirm each item (confirmed: true) or correct it; a failing test then means the product or the requirement is wrong, not only the test.

requirements.text: The login page shows an email field, a password field, a submit button and a link to registration.
The password field is masked and a toggle reveals and hides it.
Submitting without an email shows the error "Email обов'язковий".
Submitting without a password shows the error "Пароль обов'язковий".
An email with an invalid format is rejected with "Невірний формат email".
An email without "@" is blocked by the browser's own validation and nothing is submitted.
The login page links to registration.
An unknown user cannot log in and sees "Невірний email або пароль".
A registered user can log in and lands on the dashboard that shows their name.
A logged-in user can log out and returns to the login page.
The registration page shows name, email, password, password confirmation and currency fields and a submit button.
The password and confirmation fields are masked and each has a reveal/hide toggle.
The registration page links back to login.
Valid data registers a new user, who is logged in and sees the dashboard.
Empty required fields (name, email, password, confirmation) each show an error.
A name shorter than 2 characters is rejected.
An email with an invalid format is rejected.
A password shorter than 6 characters is rejected.
A confirmation that differs from the password is rejected.
An email that is already registered is rejected.
